website_summary.name: Virtual Study Hub
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and organized interface with a focus on user interaction for creating and joining study groups, designed with a consistent alice blue background and steel blue components.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a header with a welcoming message and a logout button. Below the header, there's a main content area divided into sections. The first section includes three interactive panels: "My Study Groups," "Create Study Group," and "Join Study Group." These panels are styled with a steel blue background and white text. The "Create Study Group" panel contains fields for entering a group name and description, along with a button to create the group. Similarly, the "Join Study Group" panel has a field for entering a join code and a button to join a group. At the bottom, there's a "Study Groups" section intended to list available groups. The overall design uses a consistent alice blue background, enhancing readability and visual appeal.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to manage their study groups. Users can create new groups by providing a name and description, then clicking the "Create Group" button. They can also join existing groups using a unique join code. Additionally, the website provides a space for listing all study groups, though currently, it appears empty. Future functionalities might include sharing resources within groups, participating in project discussions, and accessing a personal center for viewing user information.
